snippet.title: THE CRADLE: Episode 01 | Trailer fixed
snippet.description:
For twenty years, a station under an abandoned children's sanatorium broadcast one sound on 4625 kHz. A flat, endless hum.

Three days ago, it stopped.

September 1996. You are sent down alone, at night, to switch it back on. The night shift isn't answering. The children upstairs are still standing exactly where they were told to stand.

Don't look at them for too long.

▶ Play free in your browser (PC & phone): https://0xkot.itch.io/the-cradle-episode-01

The Cradle is a short first-person survival horror, inspired by Poppy Playtime, Amnesia, and a real Soviet radio mystery. 4625 kHz is a real frequency. Look it up after you play.

• 45–60 minutes, three endings, none of them the right one
• Fully voiced in English and Russian
• Headphones strongly recommended
